messages.text:
I can’t send the refund to a new card. If paid, it can only go to the order’s original payment; your cancelled card doesn’t change that, and its issuer handles any credit. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

I’ve proposed a refund of **BRL 150.00** for the returned cordless screwdriver. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
